basic_details.job_title: Bapu Lad Mahavidyalaya Principal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Gandhi Education Society, Kundal has invited applications for one post of Principal, open to all, at Krantiagrani Dr. G. D. Bapu Lad Mahavidyalaya, Kundal, Tal- Palus, Dist-Sangli. Applications go in writing to the undersigned, the President of the Society, within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The notice is dated 3 November 2026, so the deadline works out to about 18 November 2026 (15 days from 3 November 2026).

qualification.details: Post: Principal, 1 vacancy, reservation shown as "Open to All – 01". Educational qualification: the notice does not print it; it says that educational qualifications, pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur, from time to time. Government Resolution No. Misc-2018/C.R.56/18/UNI-1, dated 08 March 2019, for educational qualification and pay scales will remain in force. Pay: no amount is printed; the pay scale is as prescribed by the same bodies. Tenure: appointment to the post of Principal is for a period of 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the attainment of the age of superannuation of the candidate, whichever is earlier. | Candidates should check the official notification and the Government Resolution named above for the detailed eligibility of the Principal post.

important_instructions: The post of Principal is treated as open category as per the decision of the High Court, Aurangabad Bench, W/P No.3108/2023, the special leave petition of the Supreme Court W/P No. 4172/2024 and letter No.RJD/HE/KD/CIRCULAR/2024/2119 dated 09/05/2024 of the Regional Joint Director, Kolhapur Region, Kolhapur. This recruitment procedure is subject to the decision of the Bombay High Court, Aurangabad Bench, on writ petition No. 12051/2015. The vacant post and all terms and conditions apply as mentioned in No Objection letter No. JDHEKolhapur/NOC/2026/00015 dated 29.10.2026 from the Deputy Secretary (Higher Education), Mantralaya, Mumbai. All terms and conditions also apply as mentioned in the GR dated 12.11.2021 of the Higher and Technical Education Department of the Government of Maharashtra.

content_sections.heading: About Bapu Lad Mahavidyalaya
content_sections.text: Krantiagrani Dr. G. D. Bapu Lad Mahavidyalaya is a college at Kundal, Tal- Palus, Dist-Sangli, run by Gandhi Education Society, Kundal. The notice describes the college as "Permanently Granted" and is to be published at www.unishivaji.ac.in .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice asks for applications "giving full particulars" to the undersigned. The signature block reads: The President, Gandhi Education Society, Kunal, Tal- Palus, Dist- Sangli. The college letterhead gives its address as Krantiagrani Dr. G. D. Bapu Lad Mahavidyalaya, Kundal, Tal- Palus, Dist-Sangli – 416 309. The notice does not name an email address, an application form, an envelope superscription or a postal mode. Applicants who are already in service should apply through proper channel. Incomplete applications will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Post: Principal, 1 vacancy, reservation shown as "Open to All – 01". Educational qualification: the notice does not print it; it says that educational qualifications, pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur, from time to time. Government Resolution No. Misc-2018/C.R.56/18/UNI-1, dated 08 March 2019, for educational qualification and pay scales will remain in force. Pay: no amount is printed; the pay scale is as prescribed by the same bodies. Tenure: appointment to the post of Principal is for a period of 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the attainment of the age of superannuation of the candidate, whichever is earlier. Candidates should check the official notification and the Government Resolution named above for the detailed eligibility of the Principal post.

faq.question: Q1. How many Principal vacancies are there at Bapu Lad Mahavidyalaya?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Principal, shown as "Open to All – 01".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Bapu Lad Mahavidyalaya Principal post?
faq.answer: Applications are due within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. Counted from the notice date of 3 November 2026, that is about 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Principal post?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications are as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur, from time to time. Government Resolution No. Misc-2018/C.R.56/18/UNI-1 dated 08 March 2019 remains in force.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay of the Principal?
faq.answer: No amount is printed. Pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur, from time to time.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for this Principal post?
faq.answer: Apply with full particulars to the undersigned, the President, Gandhi Education Society, Kunal, Tal- Palus, Dist- Sangli, within 15 days of publication. Incomplete applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the Principal appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is for 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Principal post reserved for any category?
faq.answer: No. The post is treated as open category, with the reservation shown as "Open to All – 01".

faq.question: Q8. Can a person already in service apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants who are already in service should apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q9. Is this recruitment subject to any court decision?
faq.answer: Yes. The recruitment procedure is subject to the decision of the Bombay High Court, Aurangabad Bench, on writ petition No. 12051/2015.
